camping: No section-specific wild-camping prohibition was found for Nordingrå/Lappudden-Ullånger; ordinary allemansrätt applies.
Lappudden offers paid/service-dependent camping and should be modeled as a private/commercial campsite, not unrestricted public camping.
General guidance applies: short-term tenting on durable ground, away from homes/cultivation/grazing land, and larger groups require permission.
shelters: Körningsberget / Tree Cube is a high-confidence side-trip shelter/viewpoint/fireplace candidate.
Erikskojan is a high-confidence hut/rest-place candidate, but toilet/current amenity details need verification.
fireplaces: Naturkartan/official sources note benches/fireplace at the Körningsberget detour.
Fireplace or stove use at shelters should always be overridden by current fire-ban status and local signs.
toilets: Erikskojan toilet is supported by older official guide/FAQ style sources but conflicts with at least one field report; verify current presence before importing a separate dependable toilet.
Ullånger services, including Coop/OKQ8/hotel, provide endpoint toilet/service context depending on opening/access.

dogs.summary: No section-specific dog rule found. General Swedish dog rules apply: 1 March-20 August dogs must not run loose where wildlife may occur; leash/control is normally needed, especially near livestock.

huntingForestry.summary: No section-specific hunting or forestry closure found. Nordingrå rules do not regulate forestry; general rules apply. Visitors should not deliberately disturb hunting and should obey local signs.

closuresReroutes.summary: No current temporary closure or reroute found for Lappudden-Ullånger on official Höga Kusten Aktuellt, official section page, or Naturkartan page in the section-4 first pass.
notes: Höga Kusten Aktuellt said 'Ingen aktuell information' in the rules lane.
Currentness is page-based; local trail damage, forestry, hunting and weather issues may be posted locally or not online.

seasonalAccess.summary: No ferry is required for this section. Ullånger-Ulvön passenger boat is optional summer onward access only; bus/boat schedules must be checked close to travel date.
seasonalAccess.confidence: high for no ferry requirement; medium for schedules

safetyNotes: Official difficulty is medium; field reports support hilly sections and a strenuous climb/descent around Ringråberget/Erikskojan.
Expect material road/asphalt/gravel walking in addition to forest/lake trail.
No official exposed-scrambling warning found for this section.
For road/village walking, visibility matters in darkness; use reflectors/light on roads.

conditionReports.summary: Reviewer marked good conditions and not crowded. Activity may have started in Gavik, so exact section attribution is imperfect.
Backpacking review tags: not crowded, great conditions, great views.

Reports road walking, steep sections, gradual incline to a cabin, downhill grass path and about 20 minutes of highway/town-road walking. Also reports no toilet at the cabin, conflicting with older official guide/FAQ-style sources.

Planning/route-app source lists a mixed surface route with substantial asphalt/paved distance and highlights Lappudden, lakes, Högforstjärn, lake campsite and Kiörningsberg/Tree Cube. Use as supporting evidence only, not geometry authority.

conditionReports.source: Utsidan - Vandra Högakustenleden och besöka Trysunda
conditionReports.summary: Reports route-wide stale app/board descriptions compared with newer field routing; orange markings led correctly but sparse marking caused occasional backtracking. For this section: road after Vedasjön, nicer forest toward Ringråberget/Torrmyran, clearcuts/down to Ullånger, and Erikskojan had hikers sleeping inside.
Older report says the Erikskojan stream was dry and guestbook suggested it had been dry for years; also reports seeing moose near the route.
conditionReports.confidence: low-medium because old, but important for water-reliability caveat

conditionReports.summary: Older source reports a marked cold spring at Erikskojan was dry or only a muddy puddle, not drinkable.
Extreme drought/fire-season context: streams/springs dry, smoke/fire concern, heat, and exhausting climbs. Use as seasonal-risk note, not normal condition.

Trail-wide advice mentions asphalt/road parts, rocks, water-filter need, difficulty finding camps with water some days, and an anecdotal 2025 bear-sign note near Ullånger/Erikskojan. Do not import as official hazard.

sourceContradictions.details: Current official page and Naturkartan visible title use Etapp 4 Lappudden-Ullånger, while Naturkartan URL/GPX slug and multiple field/route-app sources use old Etapp 5 naming.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Use current Etapp 4 identity and preserve Etapp 5 only as stale alias/search metadata.

sourceContradictions.details: Current official sources list 14.6 km, Medel/Blå, 6-7 h. Legacy official PDF/guide materials list about 15 km, Krävande, 5-6 h.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Use current official section page and GPX as canonical; carry legacy values as stale-source caveat.

sourceContradictions.details: OSM relation 19096561 starts about 216.6 m from the official GPX start at Lappudden and computes about 0.5 km shorter overall.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Use official GPX as primary geometry and OSM only as QA.

sourceContradictions.details: Official section 4 GPX end and section 5 GPX start differ by about 24.8 m near Ullånger.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Accept as minor endpoint offset but track during normalization.

sourceContradictions.details: Facilities lane included a lower-latitude coordinate for Nordingrå Vallen, while transit lane and a main-thread Naturkartan Hitta hit check place the bus stop around 62.93087,18.29521.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Use 62.93087176058896,18.29520770332866 for Nordingrå Vallen bus stop. Treat the lower-latitude coordinate as stale/wrong or a different central Nordingrå point.

sourceContradictions.details: Official/Naturkartan sources list natural water near Erikskojan/Ringråberget; multiple field reports say it has been dry, muddy, or not drinkable in some years.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Import only as natural untreated water with seasonal/drought caveat; do not mark as dependable potable water.

sourceContradictions.details: Older official guide/FAQ-style sources describe a dry toilet, while at least one 2023 field report says there was no toilet at the cabin.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Import Erikskojan as hut/rest place; keep toilet as caveated or pending until verified.

sourceContradictions.details: Nordingrå is presented under Länsstyrelsen's naturreservat/besöksmål pages and WFS as a naturvårdsområde, but Länsstyrelsen says it is not an ordinary nature reserve and rules do not regulate visitor recreation.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Store as protected-area/world-heritage context, not as restrictive camping/fire visitor rules.

sourceContradictions.details: Official section page mentions summer boat connection from Ullånger to Ulvön, but the section itself requires no ferry and 2026 boat timetable was not verified.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Model as optional seasonal onward/side access only; recheck operator schedule before publication.

researchIterations.summary: Overview pass established current 9-section trail structure, tested section 4 GPX availability, and identified known section-4 topics: Lappudden/Ullånger endpoints, Nordingrå access, Kiörningsberget/Ringråberget, Ullånger services and seasonal boat note.

agents.summary: Confirmed current identity, official stats, official description, service/access notes, Nordingrå rules context and old Etapp 5/15 km/Krävande stale-source risks.
Validated Höga Kusten GPX, Naturkartan GPX, OSM relation 19096561, endpoint continuity and geometry quality. Recommended Höga Kusten GPX as primary.
Collected facility/service candidates for Lappudden, Nordingrå, Körningsberget, Vedasjön, Erikskojan/Ringråberget, Ullånger services and Ullånger boat access.
Verified Nordingrå Vallen start access, Ullånger Busstation/OKQ8 endpoint access, Kramfors regional gateway, parking/private transfer and seasonal boat access.
Reviewed AllTrails, Komoot, Utsidan, Reddit and other sources for current conditions, road/trail character, difficulty, signage, water reliability, services, camping/rest spots and seasonal issues.

Checked Nordingrå/world-heritage/protected-area context, Natura 2000, fire bans, camping, dogs/livestock, hunting/forestry, current closures/reroutes, seasonal access, water reliability and road/terrain safety.
